If the repair/resolution has been completed
Whether any follow-up actions are still pending

Don't worry about the administrative part - our central Customer Service team will take care of closing the tickets once you confirm their status.
If you could add any brief comments that might be helpful for documentation and provide your confirmation by replying to this email, that would be great!
Thanks so much for your help with this initiative! If you need any assistance or have questions, please don't hesitate to reach out to us.
